pendentes.titulo: Crédito imobiliário: novo modelo anima 60% dos compradores, diz DataZAP
pendentes.alt: Mesa de madeira clara com uma maquete branca de casa térrea, um molho de chaves e uma calculadora, perto de uma janela com luz natural
pendentes.pedido: A light oak desk beside a large window with soft morning daylight. On the desk, a small white architectural scale model of a single-story house with a pitched roof, a set of brass keys and a plain gray calculator with a blank display. A green potted plant slightly out of focus in the background. Clean minimal interior photography, shallow depth of field, eye level.

pendentes.titulo: Pé-direito alto vale a pena? O que muda na sala
pendentes.alt: Sala de estar com pé-direito alto, janelas altas de vidro, luz natural entrando e um sofá baixo de linho claro
pendentes.pedido: A bright modern living room with a very high ceiling, about five meters tall, and tall vertical windows reaching almost to the top, letting soft morning daylight fall across a light oak floor. A low beige linen sofa, a round travertine coffee table and a tall indoor olive tree in a clay pot. A slim wooden ceiling fan hangs from the ceiling. Wide-angle interior architectural photography, eye level, calm neutral palette.
